root_cause: For a spatially constant float32 velocity field, device-dependent parallel mean reduction produced a nonzero subtraction residue while the standard deviation was zero. Dividing by std.clamp_min(1e-8) amplified the constant field before the onset conditioner.
fix: Use the exact spatial max-min physical dynamic range to map constant media to zero contrast; standardize only heterogeneous fields with dynamic range greater than 1e-3 m/s.
